svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Find specific jobs on LinkedIn by searching keywords (e.g., software engineer), location,
and filters such as date posted and experience level. → Explore job opportunities on Linke
dIn, including browsing job postings and job recommendations received from the app.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Find specific jobs on LinkedIn by searching keywords (e.g., software engineer), location,
and filters such as date posted and experience level. → Apply to job opportunities on Link
edIn using the easy apply feature that automatically reuses the LinkedIn profile, saving a
pplication time.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Connect with someone they already know on LinkedIn by searching their name and sending a c
onnection request with a personalized note. → Expand professional network on LinkedIn.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Connect with people within the same LinkedIn group. → Expand professional network on Linke
dIn.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Connect with people outside the LinkedIn network, such as those with strict privacy settin
gs, via personalized connection requests. → Expand professional network on LinkedIn.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Join LinkedIn groups that look active and relevant, discovered through suggested groups ba
sed on their profile and connections. → Connect with people within the same LinkedIn group

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Receive job alert notifications with recommended job postings for saved job search filters
, via the app or email based on settings. → Explore job opportunities on LinkedIn, includi
ng browsing job postings and job recommendations received from the app.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Filter job search results by specific skills or technologies rather than just job titles o
r locations. → Look for jobs that mention specific software or programming languages.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
See posts from their network in the LinkedIn news feed, including updates from connections
, followed companies, suggested posts, and posts from joined groups. → Stay updated with t
he industry through LinkedIn.
